newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST-Tampella 96 seen in black vs loss.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Tampella 96 seen in black vs loss.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 154 million markka median forecast for Finnish engineering group Tampella Oy's full-year 1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax:
(Profit forecasts by 10 analysts, EPS by nine analysts). @
Tampella's results are due on February 21.
In 1995, Tampella posted a 188 million markka loss before extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, eight of the 10 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 189 million markka (mean 190 million) in a 145-273 million markka range.
Contributors to the survey were Aktia Bank, Carnegie, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki,
